name: Dungeon Concierge
storyline:
Our protagonist failed as a wizard and ended up taking a job as a dungeon concierge to earn a living. He works for Dungeon Masters LTD., a malevolent corporation that puts on dungeons for heroes to have their adventures.

As their employee, he’s exploited, underpaid and micromanaged by the company’s very moody fairy mascot. She is in charge of relaying the company boss' orders to the employees with a meritocratic discourse.

As our non-hero delves deeper into his job, he’ll discover that his true enemies are not those he encounters in the dungeons, but rather those who pull the strings from the shadows...
summary:
Dungeon Concierge is a fast-paced Dungeon Crawler where you play as a wizard hired by a low budget company to maintain dungeons while the heroes are away.

Clean up the aftermath of epic battles in a chaotic medieval fantasy world, while trying to stay alive. Wield powerful spells to sweep through grime, dispose of hazards, and manipulate the environment to your advantage. Complete odd jobs, fulfill contracts, and make just enough gold to put bread on the table.
